- 2023-08-11 (reported): 17 new postcards acquired, spanning roughly June–July 2023.
- 2023-11-30 (stated): 25 new postcards added since restarting collecting. The note says this count postdates the 17 acquired in June–July 2023 and the 8 acquired on 2023-11-30, so it is the latest figure for the "since restarting" period.

Reasoning: the latest record (2023-11-30) gives 25 for exactly the scope you asked about — additions since restarting collecting. The earlier 17 was an earlier, partial count of new acquisitions and is superseded within that running total. The notes give no breakdown of the 25, and your total collection size is not recorded.
